description: Specialized tree for inspecting JavaScript values.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-object-tree>
      <script type="tp/javascript">
        ({
          course: {
            title: 'Web components',
            lessons: 12,
            published: true
          },
          topics: ['HTML', 'CSS', 'JavaScript']
        })
      </script>
    </tp-object-tree>

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of an external JSON file to inspect.

methods.name: setValue(value: unknown): void
methods.description: Loads a new value into the tree.

events.name: tp-object-tree-error
events.description: Emitted when an external JSON file or inline JavaScript expression cannot be loaded.

events.name: tp-object-tree-load
events.description: Emitted after an external JSON file or inline JavaScript expression has been loaded.

events.name: tp-tree-context-action
events.description: Bubbles from the inner tree when a context-menu action is chosen. scope distinguishes global and node actions; target identifies the node or is null.
events.detail: { actionId: string; scope: "global" | "node"; target: TpTreeNodeTarget | null }

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-object-tree>` element implements the <tp-icon name="object-tree" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> Object tree functionality: specialized tree for inspecting JavaScript values.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Expand or collapse branches to inspect nested items. |
| Select | Select available links or entries to use the actions provided by the surrounding page. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
